name: Small shops
notes: Clothing, shoe, gift, book, jewellery, sports and other small shops. The stock goes early (clothes and shoes are needed), but the fittings stay: lighting, tills, alarm panels and cameras. Outdoor and surplus shops hold camping gear, music shops amplifiers and speakers, florists a walk-in cooler, tailors and fabric shops sewing machines.
access: A glass shopfront and a back door; a shopping street has dozens side by side.
